# GoldMoodAstro detailed reference

GoldMoodAstro is a Turkish-first online marketplace for astrology, tarot, numerology and personal-reflection consultations. Its canonical domain is [goldmoodastro.com](https://goldmoodastro.com).

## Entity and operator

- Brand: GoldMoodAstro
- Legal operator: Orhan Güzel – Softwareentwicklung
- Address: Stralsunder Str. 38, 41515 Grevenbroich, Germany
- EU VAT ID: DE463832419
- Contact email: [goldmoodastro@gmail.com](mailto:goldmoodastro@gmail.com)
- Supported languages: Turkish, English and German
- Primary service surface: Web, with mobile application work in progress

## Service model

GoldMoodAstro connects users with approved consultants for live audio/video sessions and supported asynchronous services. Users can compare profiles, expertise, language, service duration, pricing, reviews and availability before booking.

Checkout uses Stripe. Card payments use Stripe Checkout; PayPal can appear as a Stripe Checkout payment method for supported currencies and is not available for TRY. GoldMoodAstro does not publish payment secrets or store card details in its application database.

Live sessions use LiveKit-based platform flows. This document does not claim application-level end-to-end encryption; current security and privacy terms are defined by the live product and its legal pages.

## Calculation and content provenance

- Astrology calculations use the platform's Swiss Ephemeris-backed engine.
- Numerology calculations use the platform's deterministic numerology logic.
- Tarot, coffee and dream content use the platform's card/symbol records and editorial presentation.
- Editorial articles and visible FAQs are published on their canonical pages with structured data where applicable.

## Responsible-use policy

The service is limited to personal awareness, personal development, personal reflection and entertainment. It does not replace qualified professional or emergency services and does not promise deterministic or guaranteed outcomes. The current legal and editorial pages define the complete service boundary.
